correctness.rationale: Leaves Y_i have survival probability (i−1)/(n−1). At arrival j>i, the covariance between A_{v,j} and Y_i is (i−1)/[(n−1)(j−1)(j−2)] when i≠v, versus −(v−1)/[(n−1)(j−1)] at i=v≥2. Summing gives (j−2v)/[2(n−1)(j−2)], including root v=1 for j≥3. A sum over j gives the harmonic degree–leaf covariance, with deterministic P_2 excluded. Its first finite difference F_n(v+1)−F_n(v)=1/2−Σ_{k=v}^{n−2}1/k increases in v, proving the single crossing once F_n(2)>0 at n≥7; convexity and F_n(2)<0 establish negativity for 3≤n≤6. Harmonic asymptotics yield Φ(α) and its unique interior zero, while v=n has zero deterministic child count. Independent exhaustive rational enumeration across all parent sequences for n3..8 confirmed local and total finite formulas; no finite test proves asymptotic.
